title: #conversationswithmother #convoswithmother #carolineaaron #mattdoyle ...
transcript: Last night, I attended Conversations with Mother, a new two-hander starring Caroline Aaron and Matt Doyle as a mother and her gay son. It follows their relationship from the 70s into the present day. We see a series of scenes shared between the two of them, some of which are very dramatic, others of which are more mundane, but all of which shape their relationship as it evolves. It’s a story about life and love — tough, motherly love to be specific. I thought the script, though heavily and knowingly clichéd, was still funny and sharp. But the performances are really what's distinguishable here, with Matt Doyle in particular giving a master class in aging decades over the course of 90 minutes. I think some would consider this a comedy while others would consider it more of a tear jerker, and there's definitely a target demographic here of folks who’ll resonate with the story. But even if you fall outside of that range, I think there's still a good amount to enjoy here. With that other program for my collection.
